narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>All three numbers must be negative, because the sum is negative.
<bookmark mark='boxes'/>Try two, minus six and minus four. Two and minus six make minus four, and then minus four and minus four make minus eight.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>A positive number is allowed when a bigger negative number balances it.
